purpose: Runtime defaults for the interactive crop Markov and Monte Carlo page.

ranking_score.formula: clamp(break_even + weighted_score_brl_per_ha / normalization_scale * (weighted_score_brl_per_ha < 0 ? break_even - minimum : maximum - break_even), minimum, maximum)
ranking_score.sample_count_role: informational_only; trajectory and valid VPL counts do not change or weight any score
ranking_score.interpretation: The total score is a direct weighted combination of the economic subscore and final soil/water subscores. CVaR5 is an optional resilience measure inside economics. Sample count is informational only.

environment.total_score_formula: (1 - environment_weight) * economic_score10 + environment_weight * (soil_share * soil_score10 + water_share * water_score10)
